title: Robinson Crusoe – level 1
paragraphs: Do you want to learn English every day? We have a special book for you. The book is in three levels. You can learn English for your level.
The name of the book is Robinson Crusoe. You can find the book at www.robinsoncrusoeinlevels.com.
You can read one chapter every day. You can learn 1290 new words. You can learn grammar which is important for your level.
We hope you will enjoy the book.
